4400.meaning2: repetition of the preceding statement in verse

examples.text: yo tattha chando'ti-ādīsu yo tasmiṃ anuggaṇhane kattu'kāmatāchando'ti iminā nayena attho veditabbo. satisampajaññaṃ pan'ettha satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā ñāṇena paricchinditvā vīriya-paggahan'atthaṃ vuttaṃ.

yaṃnūn'āhaṃ yath'eva mayā pubbe bhikkhusaṅgho anuggahito, evam'eva eta'r'ahi anuggaṇheyyaṃ bhikkhusaṅghan'ti.

4410.meaning1: not grasping; not embracing; not taking up

examples.text: vissajja ganthāni mun'īdha loke, vivādajātesu na vaggasārī, santo asantesu upekkhako so, anuggaho uggahaṇanti m'aññe.
cattāro'me, āvuso, āhārā bhūtānaṃ vā sattānaṃ ṭhitiyā sambhav'esīnaṃ vā anuggahāya
n'eva davāya, na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya, vihiṃs'ūparatiyā brahmacariya-anuggahāya

na + uggahāya

examples.text: idaṃ vadāmī'ti na tassa hoti, dhammesu niccheyya samuggahītaṃ, passañ'ca diṭṭhīsu anuggahāya, ajjhattasantiṃ pacinaṃ adassaṃ.
sīlabbataṃ vā'pi pahāya sabbaṃ, kammañ'ca sāvajj'anavajjam'etaṃ, suddhiṃ asuddhin'ti apatthayāno, virato care santim'anuggahāya.
yañ'hi taṃ, āvuso, sammā vadamāno vadeyya, satthārā anuggahito sāvako mah'ābhiññataṃ patto'ti, mamaṃ taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya, satthārā anuggahito sāvako mah'ābhiññataṃ patto'ti.
katihi pan'āvuso, aṅgehi anuggahitā sammādiṭṭhi cetovimuttiphalā ca hoti cetovimuttiphal'ānisaṃsā ca, paññāvimuttiphalā ca hoti paññāvimuttiphal'ānisaṃsā cā'ti?

examples.text: iti evarūpiṃ sīlapārisuddhiṃ aparipūraṃ vā paripūressāmi paripūraṃ vā tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmī'ti, yo tattha chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañ'ca, idaṃ vuccati, byagghapajjā, sīlapārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgaṃ.

4429.commentary: (MNa) jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno'ti tato tato licchavirājagehato taṃ taṃ gehaṃ gaman'atthāya anucaṅkamamāno.

atha kho hatthako āḷavako jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno addasa bhagavantaṃ gomagge siṃsapāvane paṇṇasanthare nisinnaṃ.

4454.commentary: (ANa) anucc'āvacasīlassā'ti yassa sīlaṃ kālena hāyati, kālena vaḍḍhati, so ucc'āvacasīlo nāma hoti. khīṇ'āsavassa pana sīlaṃ ek'antavaḍḍhitam'eva. tasmā so anucc'āvacasīlo nāma hoti.

examples.text: anucc'āvacasīlassa, nipakassa ca jhāyino, cittaṃ yassa vasībhūtaṃ, ek'aggaṃ susamāhitaṃ.

4467.commentary: (DNt) anuhasantī'ti mam'uddesikaṃ mahāhasitaṃ karonti, idañ'hi anujagghantā'ti etassa saṃvaṇṇanāpadaṃ. jagghasaddo ca mahāhasane pavattati, na ujjagghikāya antaraghare gamissāmī'ti-ādīsu (pāci 586) viya.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā sakyā c'eva sakyakumārā ca sandh'āgāre uccesu āsanesu nisinnā honti aññam'aññaṃ aṅgulipatodakehi sañjagghantā saṃkīḷantā, añña'd'atthu mamaññ'eva maññe anujagghantā, na maṃ koci āsanena'pi nimantesi.

4468.grammar: opt of anujānāti, irreg form of anujāneyya, trans (+acc)

examples.text: tato adinnaṃ parivajjayeyya, kiñci kvaci sāvako bujjhamāno, na hāraye harataṃ na-anujaññā, sabbaṃ adinnaṃ parivajjayeyya.

4470.meaning1: coming after; taking after; following in the footsteps (of)
4470.commentary: (MNa) anujāto tathāgatan'ti tathāgataṃ hetuṃ anujāto, tathāgatena hetunā jāto'ti attho. apica avajāto anujāto atijāto'ti tayo vuttā. tesu avajāto dussīlo, so tathāgatassa putto nāma na hoti. atijāto nāma pitarā uttaritaro, tādiso'pi tathāgatassa putto n'atthi. tathāgatassa pana eko anujāto'va putto hoti, taṃ dassento evam'āha.

examples.text: mayā pavattitaṃ cakkaṃ, (selā'ti bhagavā) dhammacakkaṃ anuttaraṃ, sāriputto anuvatteti, anujāto tathāgataṃ.
sace te, bhaggava, agaru viharemu āvesane ekarattan'ti. na kho me, bhante, garu. atthi c'ettha pabbajito paṭhamaṃ vās'ūpagato. sace so anujānāti, viharatha, bhante, yathāsukhan'ti.
avantidakkhiṇāpathe, bhante, kaṇhuttarā bhūmi kharā gokaṇṭakahatā, app'evama bhagavā avantidakkhiṇāpathe guṇaṅ'guṇ'ūpāhanaṃ anujāneyya

sace me tvaṃ, vappa, anuññeyyañ'c'eva anujāneyyāsi, paṭikkositabbañ'ca paṭikkoseyyāsi, yassa ca me bhāsitassa atthaṃ na jāneyyāsi mam'ev'ettha uttari paṭipuccheyyāsi, idaṃ, bhante, kathaṃ, imassa ko attho'ti, siyā no ettha kathāsallāpo'ti.

4475.meaning2: causes to agree; makes give permission

examples.text: etādisaṃ ce ratanaṃ na icchasi, nāriṃ nar'indehi bahūhi patthitaṃ, diṭṭhigataṃ sīlavata-anujīvitaṃ, bhav'ūpapattiñ'ca vadesi kīdisaṃ.

4482.commentary: (SNa) anujīvino'ti ekaṃ mahākulaṃ nissāya paṇṇāsam'pi saṭṭhi'pi kulāni jīvanti, te manusse sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ. (ANa) ye c'assa anujīvino'ti ye ca etaṃ upanissāya jīvanti.

examples.text: dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ, pariggahaṃ vā'pi yadatthi kiñci, dāsā kammakarā pessā, ye c'assa anujīvino.
tath'eva sīlasampannaṃ, saddhaṃ kulapatiṃ idha, upanissāya vaḍḍhanti, puttadārā ca bandhavā, amaccā ñātisaṅghā ca, ye c'assa anujīvino.
